incidents.name: KEST transfer-fee pair skim
incidents.notes: KEST's _transfer fee logic moves KEST out of the KEST/WBNB pair without a sync, so the attacker repeatedly skimmed the pair back to itself and removed liquidity at the distorted ratio.
